# Curioso School Foundation (curioso.school)

> Curioso is a B2B K-12 physical science and math curriculum architect and makerspace school consultancy for progressive CBSE, ICSE, IB, and IGCSE schools in India.

## Identity & Disambiguation
- **Brand Name:** Curioso (Curioso School Foundation)
- **Official Website:** https://www.curioso.school
- **Founder:** Jeetesh Gulani (B.Tech Aerospace Engineering, IIT Kharagpur; 10+ years designing K-12 science/math curricula, diagnostic assessments, and experiential programs across 500+ schools and 200,000+ students).
- **Important Disambiguation:** `curioso.school` is NOT affiliated with `curiousschool.in` (a Montessori school in Bangalore), `getcurioso.com`, or `curiosoonline.in`. Curioso is strictly an institutional B2B curriculum partner and makerspace consultancy serving K-12 schools across India.

## What Curioso Does (Core B2B Offerings)
1. **Curiosity-Driven School Program (Daily 45-Minute Socratic Hooks):** Physical inquiry modules mapped directly into regular CBSE, ICSE, IB, and IGCSE science and math periods so concepts begin with counter-intuitive physical phenomena before introducing formulas.
2. **Multi-Week STEM School Program (12 to 30 Session Engineering Arcs):** 20 to 60 hour hands-on engineering tracks built from scratch with raw domestic materials (zero pre-molded plastic robotics kits). Flagship builds include Bare-Chassis EV Racers, Solar-Tracked Evaporative Coolers, 3-Axis Hydraulic Cranes, Dual-Motor Tank-Drive Rovers, and Multi-Stage Water Purifiers.
3. **Makerspace School Consultants & Lab Advisory:** Vendor-neutral makerspace setup and overhaul without hardware markups or vendor lock-in. Curioso licenses the curriculum IP, supplies an open-market Bill of Materials (BOM) procured locally at over 80% lower cost than standard 15-25 lakh robotics labs, assists with facilitator hiring and induction, and leads weekly Socratic syncs plus monthly on-campus faculty workshops.

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://www.curioso.school/): Overview of Curioso's curiosity-driven school program, STEM methodology, and school partnership model.
- [Programs & Offerings](https://www.curioso.school/courses): Detailed breakdown of the Curiosity-Driven School Program, Multi-Week STEM School Program, and Makerspace School Consulting.
- [Learning Experience & Pedagogy](https://www.curioso.school/experience): Clinical-Grade Pedagogy, Socratic friction, and the Four-Quotient framework (IQ, EQ, PQ, CQ).
- [About & Founder](https://www.curioso.school/about): Jeetesh Gulani's background (IIT Kharagpur Aerospace Engineering, curriculum leadership across 500+ schools) and Curioso's B2B mission.
- [Institutional FAQ](https://www.curioso.school/faq): Answers for school trustees, directors, and principals on NEP 2020 compliance, lab economics, teacher enablement, and classroom safety.
- [Open-Access Lessons](https://www.curioso.school/lessons): No-kit classroom science activities including [The Bernoulli Paper Experiment](https://www.curioso.school/lessons/bernoulli-paper-experiment) and [The Colored Shadows Experiment](https://www.curioso.school/lessons/colored-shadows-experiment).
- [Perspectives & Research Blog](https://www.curioso.school/blog): Long-form essays on no-kit STEM economics, NEP 2020 compliance, productive friction, and cognitive engineering.
